meta.description: Canonical registry for formal object classes in the process mathematics program.

object_classes.description: A locally distinguishable procedural configuration.
A relational admissibility reference frame.
Persistent historical or structural continuation trace.
An operator that maps admissible continuation across domains or orientations.
An admissibility-filtering operator.
A causal sphere of influence membership structure.
A bounded relational continuation region.
An admissibly realized process update.
The condition where mismatch epsilon is non-zero, requiring continuation.
The indexed set of loci alpha for which E_alpha is non-null under the declared null rule.
The ratio or measure of non-null addressable loci within the evaluated domain.
The set of candidate continuation events admitted by delta under current residue, orientation, and admissibility constraints.
A measure or count of admissible continuation events propagated across the evaluated domain.
The formal status of a transition as lying within the relevant admissibility window and satisfying residue/orientation constraints.
A region or structure where admissible continuation repeatedly re-enters a residue-conditioned admissibility regime.
A stabilized recurrence basin sustained through recursive admissible continuation under residue constraints.
The formal status of a symbolic reduction step as satisfying all registered admissibility and preservation constraints.
A formal transformation between symbolic states in a reduction chain.
A sequence of operator compositions with a finite or conditionally finite length.
A symbolic rewrite rule that preserves process-determinant membership and admissibility.
